common.portalTitle: Yojna Setu • National Scheme Bridge Portal
common.ministryName: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India
common.tagline: Bridging Entrepreneurs to Concessional Credit & Government Welfare Schemes

hero.title: Empowering Entrepreneurs with Concessional Credit & Welfare
hero.description: Discover tailored NSFDC loan schemes with lower interest rates, compute reducing-balance EMIs with moratorium benefits, and locate authorized State Channelising Agencies & Banks near you.

schemes.title: Smart Scheme Recommender
schemes.subtitle: Answer 4 simple questions to find the most suitable concessional loan schemes for your business or education.
schemes.step1Desc: Select what activity or purpose you require funding for.
schemes.step2Desc: What is the total estimated financial requirement?
schemes.step3Desc: Enter total annual household income (must be ≤ ₹5.00 Lakhs for NSFDC schemes).
schemes.step4Desc: Help us match special subsidies (women entrepreneurs, education level, sanitation).
schemes.incomeWarningLimit: NSFDC schemes are targeted for beneficiaries with family income up to ₹5,00,000/year (both rural and urban areas).
schemes.resultsSubtitle: Schemes ranked by eligibility fit, maximum funding ratio, and interest concession benefits.
schemes.noMatchTitle: No Exact Match Found with current filters
schemes.noMatchDesc: Try adjusting your project cost or checking family income criteria. NSFDC schemes support projects up to ₹50 Lakhs with annual family income up to ₹5 Lakhs.

calculator.title: Concessional EMI Calculator
calculator.subtitle: Calculate monthly installment (reducing balance), total interest outlay, and see how moratorium grace periods ease your startup cashflow.
calculator.interestRebateNote: Women entrepreneurs receive an additional 0.5% p.a. interest rebate.
calculator.moratoriumNote: During moratorium, principal repayment is deferred so your business can start generating revenue.

partners.title: Channel Partner & District Branch Locator
partners.subtitle: Locate authorized State Channelising Agencies (SCAs), Public Sector Banks, and RRBs nearest to you to submit your loan application.
partners.disclaimer: Partner fund-utilization data pending NSFDC integration — this is sample data for demo purposes.
partners.searchPlaceholder: Search by district, city, or partner name...
partners.locationPrompt: Click 'Use My Location' or select a district to calculate driving distance.

ai.title: Yojna Setu Scheme & Document Assistant
ai.subtitle: Ask questions in simple English or Hindi about scheme guidelines, required documents, or application procedures.
ai.inputPlaceholder: Ask a question (e.g., 'What documents do I need for Mahila Samriddhi?', 'How does the moratorium work?')...
ai.sample1: What documents are required for Micro Credit Finance?
ai.sample2: How much loan can I get for an E-Rickshaw under Green Business Scheme?
ai.sample3: What is the interest rate concession for women entrepreneurs?
ai.sample4: How do I apply through my State Channelising Agency (SCA)?
